NV-2027-SB17.title: Revises provisions relating to orders for protection against harassment in the workplace. (BDR 3-568)

actions.text: Prefiled. Referred to Committee on Judiciary. To printer.

NV-2027-SB17.description: AN ACT relating to public safety; revising provisions relating to the procedure for the issuance of a temporary order for protection against harassment in the workplace; and providing other matters properly relating thereto.
NV-2027-SB17.descriptionSource: Official alternate title (state legislature, via Open States)
